responsibility: Defines the master list of RTL REG_NOTE and REG_CFA_NOTE codes used on instruction note chains throughout GCC. It is included via macros to generate enums or related tables and documents the semantic meaning of scheduler dependence notes, liveness notes, branch prediction notes, CFA/unwind annotations, EH and transactional markers, IRA/LRA communication notes, and other per-insn metadata categories. This file is declarative infrastructure rather than executable pass logic.
